# gataslab.org

This repository holds the **built** GATAS Lab website. Every commit here is one
snapshot of the site, published by GitHub Pages.

**Do not edit anything in this repository.** It is overwritten in full by CI on
every deploy, so changes made here are lost on the next build.

The site's sources — content, layouts and history — live in a separate, private
repository in this organisation. If you are a lab member and want to change the
site, work there. If you are not and you have found a problem with the site,
please email fairbanksj [at] ufl [dot] edu.

The site is built with [Hugo](https://gohugo.io/) and the
[Relearn](https://mcshelby.github.io/hugo-theme-relearn/) theme. The code in the
source repository is MIT licensed; the copy on the pages of the website is
copyright James Fairbanks, all rights reserved.
